name: Road Town
where: Off Road Harbour, in the middle of the Sir Francis Drake Channel
teaches: Flat water and a steady trade wind. Reach across to Dead Chest, run down to Nanny Cay and beat home.

name: The Bight
where: Off Norman Island, at the mouth of the Bight
teaches: The beat every charter boat makes: out past the Indians and up the channel to Cooper Island, tack on tack.

name: North Sound
where: Inside Virgin Gorda's North Sound, off Bitter End
teaches: Pilotage. Out by the channel past Colquhoun Reef, then a run down the back of Virgin Gorda with the trades behind.

name: Great Harbour
where: Off Jost Van Dyke, outside Great Harbour
teaches: Island hopping on the north side: across to Sandy Cay and on to Cane Garden Bay, through the wind shadow and the puffs under Tortola.
